classificationDefinitions.ENFORCED: an executable artefact proves it (test, verifier script, migration, policy or machine-checked contract match) and, where a boundary is declared, a real call site invokes it
classificationDefinitions.DECLARED: a module, document or contract mentions it, but nothing executable proves it
classificationDefinitions.IMPLEMENTED_UNWIRED: implementation and tests exist, but the declared boundary patterns match nothing — the capability protects nothing yet

ownership.note: Phase 16 owns twin identity, state, relationships, observations and governance. Canonical records, authorization decisions and civilization federation remain outside this phase.

areas.area: Twins have stable identity and governed lifecycle
areas.requirement: Twin creation requires identity, tenant and source material; lifecycle transitions are ordered and terminal retirement/deletion rules are enforced.

areas.area: Observations preserve provenance and state history
areas.requirement: Observations retain source and timing, invalid or future observations fail closed, and current or historical state is reconstructed without overwriting history.

areas.area: Twin relationships are explicit, acyclic where required and tenant-governed
areas.requirement: Relationships preserve identity, reject self-links and cycles, detect dangling references and deny cross-tenant links without governance.

areas.area: Derived state, simulation and drift remain distinguishable
areas.requirement: Simulation is isolated, predictions remain distinct from actuals, health and fidelity are explainable, and drift resolution follows ordered steps.

areas.area: Twin access and manual overrides are attributable
areas.requirement: Access is tenant and relationship scoped; sensitive data and overrides require policy, actor, reason and evidence, with expiry and reconciliation.

areas.area: Twin engines are not yet invoked by a live boundary
areas.requirement: A runtime or authorised server boundary must consume telemetry and project governed twin state; current evidence proves the libraries and tests only.

limitations: Classification measures the presence of executable evidence, not the correctness or completeness of that evidence.
A DECLARED area is unfinished work, never a false claim — it is reported as such.
An IMPLEMENTED_UNWIRED area has a tested implementation that no boundary calls; it is reported, never counted as enforcement.
Evidence patterns are declared per phase in architecture/phase-acceptance/phase-<id>-*.json and must be reviewed when a phase is re-audited.
